articleTitle: Why Your Estradiol Gel Sits on Your Skin for Hours
imageHeadline: Your Estradiol Gel Isn't Absorbing? Here's Why
imageSubtext: What affects absorption time and what you can actually do about it
pinTitle: Why Estradiol Gel Takes Hours to Absorb (And What Affects It)
pinDescription: If your estradiol gel sits on your skin for hours or leaves residue the next morning, there are specific factors at play. Learn what influences transdermal hormone absorption and evidence-based adjustments you can try for better results.
